pages.en: Today is Grandma's birthday. The whole family comes to her house: Mum, Dad, Lily, Tom, Aunt Kate, Uncle Ben and cousin Sam.
pages.zh: 今天是奶奶的生日。全家人都来到她家：妈妈、爸爸、Lily、Tom、Kate 姑姑、Ben 叔叔和表哥 Sam。
pages.scene: The whole family arriving at Grandma's front door with presents and flowers, Grandma welcoming them with open arms.

pages.en: Grandpa makes a big cake. Lily and Sam carry it to the table. Tom wants to eat the cake now, but Grandpa says, "Not yet!"
pages.zh: 爷爷做了一个大蛋糕。Lily 和 Sam 把它端到桌上。Tom 现在就想吃蛋糕，可是爷爷说：“还不行！”
pages.scene: Grandpa holding a big birthday cake while Lily and Sam put candles on it, Tom reaching for the cake and Grandpa smiling and shaking his finger.

pages.en: Everyone sings "Happy Birthday". Grandma is very happy. "I love my family," she says, and she gives everyone a big piece of cake.
pages.zh: 大家一起唱《生日快乐》。奶奶非常开心。“我爱我的家人。”她说，然后给每个人切了一大块蛋糕。
pages.scene: The family around a table singing, Grandma smiling in front of the cake with lit candles, cutting big pieces of cake.

questions.q: Tom eats the cake before the song.
questions.zh: Tom 在唱歌之前就吃了蛋糕。
